title: Today's sales total from the sales you record
summary: Every evening, add up the sales you recorded by chat or on the Stock page and send the owner the total.
description: Every day at the time you choose, adds up the day's sales you recorded with *sold …* in chat or Record a sale on the Stock page: the total, by cash, transfer and terminal, how many sales, and what sold most. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email. A day with no sales sends nothing.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the total is sent, Lagos time.

input.message: ="Today's sales: NGN " + string(double(steps.day.output.total_kobo) / 100.0) + ' from ' + string(steps.day.output.count) + ' sales (cash NGN ' + string(double(steps.day.output.cash_kobo) / 100.0) + ', transfer NGN ' + string(double(steps.day.output.transfer_kobo) / 100.0) + ', terminal NGN ' + string(double(steps.day.output.pos_kobo) / 100.0) + ')' + (steps.day.output.top != '' ? '. Sold most: ' + steps.day.output.top : '')
